Astitva is the biggest youth festival in India organized By Mr. Ashutosh Pratihast. The festival is a celebration of youth culture, creativity, and talent, bringing together students from different parts of India to Learn from the experts, and showcase their skills and abilities & experience the ultimate fun & entertainment

The festival features a wide range of events and activities, including music, dance, theater, literature, art, and sports competitions, among others. These events provide a platform for students to exhibit their talents and skills and engage in healthy competition with their peers.

Apart from the events, Astitva also features thought-provoking & insightful talks and workshops by eminent personalities from various fields to inspire and motivate youth to pursue their dreams and goals.

The primary objective of Astitva is to provide a platform for students to explore and develop their talents, build new relationships and networks, and gain exposure to new ideas and experiences. It is a celebration of the spirit of youth and creativity, and the festival attracts thousands of participants and visitors every year from across the country.

Overall, Astitva is an exciting and dynamic festival that celebrates the vibrancy and diversity of youth culture in India, and it is an event that should not be missed by anyone who wants to experience the energy and enthusiasm of the Indian youth.
